preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Trading must be currently enabled (tradingEnabled == true)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the enableTrading() function. This will fail because the function has a require statement that checks if tradingEnabled == false, but trading is already enabled. This permanently prevents any new trading transactions since the function cannot be called again to re-enable trading if it gets disabled. The exploit demonstrates that once trading is enabled, it cannot be disabled and re-enabled due to the flawed logic in enableTrading().
